purpose: The 27 requested exploration priorities. Traits are production hypotheses, not performance evidence or licensed artwork. Brand constraints and actual material quality govern adaptation.

styles.title: Anthropomorphic
styles.traits: Human traits in a relevant object or character; use licensed imagery or a well-rendered raster scene.

styles.title: Mixed Media
styles.traits: Combine photographs, scanned textures and type with a clear focal point.

styles.title: Bento grid
styles.traits: Modular content grouping for related evidence; avoid equal-weight clutter.

styles.title: Aurora
styles.traits: Luminous flowing color fields supporting a restrained subject and legible type.

styles.title: Ethereal
styles.traits: Soft light, translucency and airy imagery; preserve contrast.

styles.title: Cybercore
styles.traits: Dense digital and technological imagery with controlled hierarchy; avoid fake product proof.

styles.title: Neoclassical
styles.traits: Classical proportion and architectural or sculptural references with contemporary clarity.

styles.title: Bauhaus
styles.traits: Functional hierarchy, assertive type and balanced geometric source imagery.

styles.title: Pixel art (8-bit, bitmap)
styles.traits: Deliberately low-resolution raster imagery with crisp scaling and readable separate text.

styles.title: Farmhouse or cottage-core
styles.traits: Domestic craft, natural surfaces and intimate rural imagery when relevant.

styles.title: Japandi
styles.traits: Restrained natural materials, considered space and warm simplicity; avoid cultural caricature.

styles.title: Memphis
styles.traits: Playful rhythmic sourced patterns and energetic composition with a clear anchor.

styles.title: Kitsch
styles.traits: Intentional exuberance, nostalgic novelty and playful excess for a receptive audience.

styles.title: Luxury Typography
styles.traits: Expressive type proportions, careful spacing and restrained supporting imagery.

styles.title: Biomorphic
styles.traits: Organic forms and natural rhythms from suitable existing imagery or raster rendering.

styles.title: Brutalism
styles.traits: Direct raw composition, forceful type and exposed structure without sacrificing readability.

styles.title: Chinoiserie
styles.traits: Historically contextual decorative source material; verify provenance and cultural fit.

styles.title: Minimalism
styles.traits: Remove competing elements around one meaningful subject or claim.

styles.title: Conceptual sketch (doodle art)
styles.traits: Hand-drawn conceptual imagery sourced or rendered as raster, with real explanatory purpose.

styles.title: Risograph
styles.traits: Limited-ink print character and tactile grain from suitable raster materials.

styles.title: Rubberhose
styles.traits: Early cartoon-inspired elastic character imagery from licensed or permitted raster sources.

styles.title: Steampunk
styles.traits: Mechanical material detail and alternative-era imagery where the concept warrants it.

styles.title: Synthwave
styles.traits: Retro-futurist lighting and cinematic imagery with controlled high contrast.

styles.title: Tenebrism
styles.traits: Dramatic selective light against deep shadow to reveal a decisive subject.

styles.title: Type-collage
styles.traits: Layered typographic fragments with an intentional reading order and intact script shaping.

styles.title: Vaporwave
styles.traits: Nostalgic digital surrealism with deliberate color and cultural context.

styles.title: Y2K design
styles.traits: Turn-of-millennium digital gloss and playful technology cues without illegible ornament.
